task: Move immutable BCM2837 IRQ numbers and BCM2836 Core0 source masks into SoC data without changing interrupt behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The BCM27xx profile owns immutable IRQ topology values.
Existing ARM HAL public IRQ constants remain compatible aliases.
System-timer enable and pending masks consume the SoC IRQ value.
C1 acknowledgement, timer period, dispatch, and register offsets remain ARM HAL mechanisms.
